gaps: Fandom returned 403 and Buildstation has no public JSON API, so this catalog is not a full item dump.

Attribute max values are stored only for Weapon Damage (15%), Critical Hit Chance (6%), and Critical Hit Damage (12%), from the Coyote's Mask and Ridgeway's Pride wiki pages. Other attributes have no max.
Per-brand hex colours were not in a source I could fetch. Builder tiles use rarity gradients (green gear set, gold high-end, orange exotic) like the Buildstation board.
Weapon talent descriptions and brand chest/backpack talent descriptions are not stored.
Agitator, Whiplash, Robin, Bulldog, Interchange, and Trader have no weapon type in the Buildstation changelog, so they show under Unclassified.
Core Strength bonuses were not on the fetched wiki gear-set table.
Specialization grenade proper names were not re-fetched; each row is tied to its specialization.
High-end weapon models are a working set, not every blueprint in the game.
Skill variants may miss a variant added after the list was written.
